binjgb — vendored emulator core
===============================

Upstream:  https://github.com/binji/binjgb
           commit c60e138da5a795ebb55e56b11b7e90024e41112c (2026-06-16)
Fork:      https://github.com/christopherfretz/binjgb
           branch pyrite-rtc, commit b91486087e74a6ab74eefd71143e96dd2401c5bd
           = upstream c60e138d + two commits:
             8fb6fda "Export an MBC3 RTC getter/setter for embedders"
                     (CLK1, 2026-09-27)
             b914860 "Add a link port: a host-driven stand-in for the link
                     cable" (LK1a, 2026-10-15)
Source:    git submodule ../binjgb-src (pinned to the fork commit above)
Licence:   MIT (see LICENSE; docs/simple.js and docs/demo.js, from which this
           page's core glue was adapted, additionally carry LICENSE.gbstudio)

What the fork adds (src/emulator.c, emulator.h, emscripten/exported.json):

    f64  emulator_get_rtc_seconds_f64(Emulator*)
    Bool emulator_set_rtc_seconds_f64(Emulator*, f64 seconds)

The MBC3 real-time clock as whole seconds, day*86400 + h*3600 + m*60 + s,
including the ticks not yet folded into the registers.  The getter returns -1
and the setter FALSE on a cartridge without an MBC3 timer.  The setter keeps
the halt flag, sets day-carry only past 511 days (app.js never does), and
restarts the sub-second phase.  EmulatorState is NOT changed, so save states
and the resume snapshot from the unpatched core still load (app.js
COMPAT_CORES).  Both functions are exported as _emulator_get_rtc_seconds_f64
and _emulator_set_rtc_seconds_f64.

    void emulator_link_enable(Emulator*, Bool)
    void emulator_link_set_idle_in(Emulator*, u8)
    u32  emulator_link_push_in(Emulator*, const u8*, u32 len)
    u32  emulator_link_in_pending(Emulator*)
    void emulator_link_clear_in(Emulator*)
    void emulator_link_set_ext_clock(Emulator*, u32 mode, u32 gap_ticks,
                                     u32 idle_period_ticks)
    u32  emulator_link_drain_out(Emulator*, u32* dst, u32 max)
    u32  emulator_link_peek(Emulator*)
    s32  emulator_link_clock_external(Emulator*, u8 in)

The link port (docs/LK1-LINK.md section 2): a byte FIFO that feeds the other
end of the serial cable, a paced virtual master for external-clock transfers,
and a log of every completed byte.  It lives in struct Emulator, NOT in
EmulatorState, so SAVE_STATE_VERSION and sizeof(EmulatorState) (199608) are
unchanged and states from the two earlier cores still load.  It is off by
default; with it off the core is behaviourally identical to 8fb6fda, which
web/test/identity.mjs checks side by side (frames, SRAM and state bytes).
All nine are exported with a leading underscore.

Build (build.sh here; the committed artefacts are its output):

    Emscripten 5.0.7 (the version upstream used for its own docs/binjgb.*)
    cmake -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=<emsdk>/upstream/emscripten/cmake/Modules/Platform/Emscripten.cmake
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DWERROR=ON -DWASM=true
          -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-ffile-prefix-map=<src>=binjgb
    i.e. upstream's `make demo` / `make wasm`, plus a prefix map so the
    assert() file names do not embed the checkout path.  Link flags come from
    the fork's CMakeLists.txt: -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME="Binjgb",
    emmalloc, a fixed 16.5 MB heap (258 wasm pages, no memory growth), and
    EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS from src/emscripten/exported.json.  RGBDS_LIVE and
    GBSTUDIO are off, which is why `_set_audio_channel_mute` is the no-op stub
    in this build and app.js mutes in JavaScript instead.  The imgui
    submodule of binjgb is not needed and is left uninitialised.

sha256:
    6d448da28611d53d8d57f0fdf0ea7788a1d35211346bed8ecee7cb37fdee1233  binjgb.js
    056cf5b50366fd9a5b5591c39f7c1ee55f595c74fb2658f5367cba78a029254d  binjgb.wasm
  (8fb6fda's build was f011e737...720f / 3818651d...18c8.)

Reproducibility: the build is byte-identical from any checkout path.  Built
the same way from unmodified upstream c60e138d, binjgb.js matches upstream's
committed docs/binjgb.js exactly.  binjgb.wasm differs from upstream's by a
few hundred bytes (upstream's embeds its build machine's file names).
LICENSE and LICENSE.gbstudio are verbatim from upstream.

To refresh:

    git -C <pyrite> submodule update --init web/vendor/binjgb-src
    (commit to the fork's pyrite-rtc branch; move the submodule to it)
    EMSDK=<emsdk> web/vendor/binjgb/build.sh     # or with emcc on PATH
    # then update the hashes here and CORE_COMMIT in web/app.js, and
    # (layout unchanged) add the old CORE_COMMIT to COMPAT_CORES.
    tools/emsdk/node/*/bin/node web/test/identity.mjs   # must PASS
    tools/emsdk/node/*/bin/node web/test/linkport.mjs

Changing the core's EmulatorState layout invalidates every save *state* and
the auto-resume snapshot, because they are raw dumps of that struct.  app.js
therefore stamps each stored state with CORE_COMMIT and refuses to load one
from a core not in COMPAT_CORES.  Battery saves (`.sav`) are unaffected: they
are plain cartridge RAM, 32768 bytes, no footer.  The RTC is not in the .sav;
the player keeps it in its own IndexedDB record (`clock:<title>`).
